subject: let the width of the plot exceed the tab page

messages.author: d9414d5293ddc8b1
messages.subject: let the width of the plot exceed the tab page
parts:
Hello ~

I would like to make the reactive plot have varied width and height, depending on the size of underlying data. 
Therefore, I have tried to control the size of my plot using two functions: getVarHeight and getVarWidth in the server.R. 
Then I present the plot in the web page with setting height="auto", width="auto" in the ui.R. 

It works nice for controlling the height. However, it seems like the width of the plot is limited to width of my web page. 
I have tried to modify width="auto"  to width="400%". I did see the increase of width of the plot. 

However, it is done manually. 

I wonder if there is a way to not limit the plot width in the unscrolled page. 

Thank you, 

Ray


#################

server.R

 output$plot <- renderPlot({
    get_plot()
  }, height=getVarHeight, width=getVarWidth)

ui.R

tabPanel( "Plot", plotOutput("plot", height="auto", width="auto"))
